But likely they expect us to call a function that returns the SMILES of the sample. There is no such function. However, we could use "simulate_spectra" which takes SMILES and returns spectra, not the reverse.

Maybe the sample is already known in the system; perhaps we can call "return_possible_fragments" which returns fragments of the sample. That might include SMILES? Not sure.
